false.generic_scheduling_is_not_enough: Generic scheduling words alone — calendar, schedule, free, busy, availability, meeting, event — do not activate Google Calendar for this user. Those route to their configured provider instead.
false.means: `user_request` can be fully handled without Google Calendar.

true.explicit_only: This user has Google Calendar set to explicit-only. Yes requires the request to name Google Calendar (`google calendar`, `google cal`, `gcal`), or to be an explicit generic-calendar request whose configured provider is google_calendar.
true.ignore_availability: Judge only whether the service is needed. Whether it is currently connected must not change the answer — availability is handled separately.
true.means: Answering or acting on `user_request` needs Google Calendar.
true.not_for: A request that explicitly names another service by name (Todoist) and does not independently need Google Calendar. Prefer the minimal set of services: naming one service does not pull in the others.
